caption: The drawing depicts two views of a long dress with puffed short sleeves and a wide skirt, rendered in fine black outlines on a beige background. The dress has large, gathered sleeves and lace or frilled detailing at the cuffs and neckline. The secondary, smaller illustration in the background shows the back and opposite side view of the same dress with similar details, including the gathered skirt and puffed sleeves, and highlights the rear seam lines.
